verdict.rationale: Justworks is an HR/payroll SaaS platform, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains only UI help articles about payroll, benefits, time off and the Xero integration. The '/api/v2/' in the source URLs belongs to the help-center hosting platform, not to a Justworks product API, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404. Nothing documents API versioning or a deprecation policy.
